diagnostics.message: `FsRead` cannot read files itself, because it only attenuates. Attenuate it to a directory first and call `read_to_string` on that: `read.restrict_to("<root>").read_to_string(path)`, where the root is the directory the program should reach. For a single file, use `restrict_to_file("<file>")` and call `read_to_string` with no path

`FsWrite` cannot write files itself, because it only attenuates. Attenuate it to a directory first and call `write` on that: `write.restrict_to("<root>").write(path, text)`, where the root is the directory the program should reach. For a single file, use `restrict_to_file("<file>")` and call `write` with no path

`Fs` cannot read files itself, because it only attenuates. Attenuate it to a directory first and call `list_dir` on that: `fs.read_only().restrict_to("<root>").list_dir(path)`, where the root is the directory the program should reach
